_role: LEARNER DATA. This file is read by the LEARNER boundary only. It must never contain the intended concept name, an intended invariant, an expected label, or any evaluation key. _domain: a withdrawn personal domain whose point is recovery away from observation; the fillers are deliberately non-architectural where possible
